newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain 91-day treasury bill unchanged at 5.49 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain 91-day treasury bill unchanged at 5.49 pct.

text.p: The average rate at this week's tender for 10 million dinars worth of 91-day Bahrain treasury bills was unchanged from last week's 5.49 percent, a Bahrain Monetary Agency spokesman said on Monday.
The average price was marginally higher at 98.632 from 98.631. The minimum price accepted was unchanged at 98.629.
Banks submitted bids for 26.6 million dinars worth of bills, up from from 22.1 million dinars a week ago.
The bills are offered on Monday and issued on Wednesday.
